column3: What is important to the "Resource" element in PEAR is {focusing} on identifying the need for additional resources.
In this case, the light energy is {focused} on a collector-base junction.
After clearing the obstacle, maintain the power {setting} and accelerate to the normal climb speed.
The altimeter {setting} broadcast by ground stations is the station pressure corrected to mean sea level.
It must be noted that in flight below 18,000 feet, the altimeter {setting} is changed to match that of the closest available weather reporting station or airport.
Some carburetor installations use twoposition manual mixture controls that provide a lean mixture {setting} for cruising economy and a richer mixture setting for all powers above cruising.
For the remainder of the maneuver, the trim {setting} remains unaltered.
